verdict.rationale: Conductor sends code and prompts to agents and hosts cloud workspaces, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, no documentation describes a training opt-out setting or a policy against using customer data for training. The only related items are a developer comment that local chats run through the user's own Claude Code installation, and community remarks that Conductor's data practices are undisclosed. Neither amounts to an opt-out control.
